_comment: Page copy for /g/uk-google-ads (27 Nov 2026): Google Ads on a fixed monthly fee for UK service businesses. The UK copy of the Norwegian leads.elevatemarketing.no/google-ads page, moving company case left out. Figures from the clients' own Google Ads accounts, anonymised; see LAUNCH.md.

meta.title: Google Ads on a fixed fee | Elevate Marketing
meta.description: Google Ads for UK businesses on a fixed monthly fee from £1,000, no minimum term. See the numbers from the accounts we run.

cta: Book a 30 minute Google Ads review

hero.h1a: Google Ads that pays for itself.

ingress.t: We run Google Ads on a fixed monthly fee, with no minimum term. One private clinic group we run it for had
632 bookings in two months, at £45 each
. These are the accounts' own numbers.

hero.micro: A few questions, about two minutes, so we come prepared.

how.h2: Fewer clicks that go nowhere. More of what sells.
how.intro: Most Google Ads accounts we look at spend a large share of the budget on searches that never turn into a customer. The fix is not more traffic. It is measuring what actually sells, and moving the budget there.

items.t: An honest look at the account
items.p: We go through where the money goes today, and which searches bring bookings, sales or enquiries.
We measure bookings, sales and enquiries that matter. Not clicks and impressions.
Budget moves to the searches where people are ready to buy, and away from the ones that do not deliver.
Every month you see what the ads cost and what they brought back, in pounds.

fit.h2: For businesses that already advertise, and want it to pay.
fit.body: The businesses we work best with sell a service or a product people search for, can tell a booking or a sale from a click, and want the budget spent where it brings customers back.
yes: You are a UK business that can put £2,000 a month or more into Google Ads
People search for what you sell: a treatment, a trade, a service or a product
A new customer is worth {WORTH} or more to you
Someone can answer a new enquiry within one working day
no: You cannot put £2,000 a month into Google Ads
You want a guaranteed number of leads
Nobody has time to approve ads or answer enquiries
fit.note: We check the details you give after you apply.

pay.h2: A fixed monthly fee, from £1,000. No minimum term.
pay.body: We manage your Google Ads for a fixed monthly fee, from £1,000 a month, agreed in writing before anything runs. It does not grow with your ad budget, so we have no reason to tell you to spend more. The fee depends on the scope, so we confirm it on the first call.
open: The fee covers campaign build, search term clean-up, ads, landing page advice and monthly reporting.
There is no setup fee and no minimum term. You can stop with 30 days' notice.
We invoice monthly in advance. Payment terms are 14 days.
The advertising budget is separate. You pay it to Google directly, in your own account, and we agree it with you before anything runs.

items.p: Nothing goes live until you have seen it. Text and images that the platforms generate on their own are switched off unless you want them.
Campaigns run in a Google Ads account you own, tracked in your own systems. If we stop, you keep everything.
No minimum term. If we do not deliver, you give 30 days' notice.

rows.status: What Google Ads is set to win
What we bring down month by month

meeting.body: We do not pitch. If you run Google Ads today, we look at your account with you. If you do not, we look at what your competitors bid on.

steps.p: We go through where the budget goes, which searches bring customers and what we would change first.
You receive a one page sheet: the changes we would make first and what a customer should cost.

meeting.closing: You keep the sheet whether or not we work together.

items.a: A fixed monthly fee for the management, from £1,000 a month and confirmed on the first call, plus the ad budget you pay to Google.

items.q: Why £2,000 a month in ad budget?
items.a: Below that there is too little data for changes to make a measurable difference, and a fixed fee becomes too large a share of the spend. It would not pay for you.

items.q: Your clients are Norwegian. Why would this work here?
items.a: The mechanism is the same: searches with intent to buy, tracking that counts customers, and budget moved to what sells. What differs is competition and cost per click, and we go through those on the first call.
No. We work month to month, with 30 days' notice, and you keep the accounts and the data.
No. We can show you what we have done and how. We cannot promise a number of customers.

items.q: Who are the clients in the examples?
items.a: They are anonymised. The figures come straight from their Google Ads accounts, and we are glad to show more on the call.

book.h: Thank you. Choose a time that suits you.
book.p: Pick a slot for a {OFFER}. There is nothing to prepare.
book.small: No time that works? Reply to the confirmation email and we will find one.

takk.p: We will send a confirmation. There is nothing to prepare. If you run Google Ads today, we sort out read-only access together on the call.

review.h: Thank you. We will be in touch within one working day.
review.p: We want to check a few details before we suggest a time.

not-now.h: Thank you. Come back when the timing is right.
not-now.p: We will be glad to hear from you then.

not-a-fit.h: Thank you. This is not the right fit at the moment.
not-a-fit.p: We work with UK businesses that can put £2,000 a month or more into Google Ads. If that changes, we would be glad to hear from you.
not-a-fit.note: If we have misread your answers, email {EMAIL} and we will look again.

interest.h: Looking for a new website instead?
interest.p: If you would like a fixed-price quote for a new website, press the button and we will email you once, within two working days. A person at Elevate Marketing also reads every application, and may email you once about this if we think it could suit your business. Every email says how to say no.
interest.done: Thank you. We will email you from {EMAIL} within two working days.
interest.error: That did not go through. Email {EMAIL} and ask for a quote, and we will send one.
interest.noscript: To ask for a quote on a new website, email {EMAIL}.

cases.h2: Their Google Ads accounts. Their numbers.

items.name: Private clinic group
items.sub: Bookings for consultations and treatment, 2 months

cases.note: Clients anonymised. Sales are conversion value as Google Ads measures it. The clinic's revenue is estimated from its own averages: 632 bookings × 90% attendance × £142, and 65% go on to treatment at £3,285. For the law firm, enquiries are form submissions and phone clicks in its strongest 14 months; later months were lower. Pound figures converted from Norwegian kroner at 0.073.
